explication: Ralph is a command-line autonomous development loop for Claude Code. A project owner supplies requirements and starts the loop; Ralph repeatedly invokes the coding agent, evaluates responses and progress, and stops only when its completion conditions are met. Rate limits, circuit breaking, and error detection constrain that runtime. Separate capabilities import tasks, enable projects, monitor runs, and report metrics. The README documents these capabilities, but only the E2B helper was sampled from source, so its connection to the loop is shown as unverified.
